    D

    decodeEntities(String) - Static method in class network.ike.docs.typst.TypstText
    Decodes the HTML entities Asciidoctor's substitutions produce.

    E

    escapeMarkup(String) - Static method in class network.ike.docs.typst.TypstText
    Escapes plain text for Typst markup mode: the characters that open expressions, styling, math, labels, references and comments, the shorthands (--, -?, ...), a ; (which would silently end a preceding code expression), and the line-leading characters that start lists, headings and terms.

    F

    fence(String) - Static method in class network.ike.docs.typst.TypstText
    A raw block fence that cannot be closed by the content: one more backtick than the longest run inside, never fewer than three.

    L

    label(String) - Static method in class network.ike.docs.typst.TypstText
    A Typst label reference, <name>, from an AsciiDoc id.
    labelName(String) - Static method in class network.ike.docs.typst.TypstText
    The bare label name for an AsciiDoc id.

    M

    markup(String) - Static method in class network.ike.docs.typst.TypstText
    Turns Asciidoctor-substituted text into Typst markup: decodes HTML entities and escapes markup-significant characters outside protected spans, and restores protected spans verbatim.
    MITEX_IMPORT - Static variable in class network.ike.docs.typst.TypstPageSetup
    The mitex import for documents with LaTeX math: 0.2.7 is the first release that compiles under Typst 0.15 (0.2.5 fails on a removed math symbol).

    O

    OPEN - Static variable in class network.ike.docs.typst.TypstText
    Opens a protected span (finished Typst inside substituted text).

    P

    plain(String) - Static method in class network.ike.docs.typst.TypstText
    Turns substituted text into plain text: entities decoded, protected spans restored, nothing escaped.
    preamble(String, boolean) - Static method in class network.ike.docs.typst.TypstPageSetup
    The preamble for a document.
    protect(String) - Static method in class network.ike.docs.typst.TypstText
    Wraps finished Typst so that the substitutions Asciidoctor still runs on the surrounding text (macros, replacements, post-replacements) never see it, and a later TypstText.markup(String) or TypstText.plain(String) pass restores it verbatim.

    T

    TypstConverter - Class in network.ike.docs.typst.asciidoc
    AsciidoctorJ converter for the typst backend: walks the Asciidoctor AST and emits Typst source.
    TypstConverter(String, Map) - Constructor for class network.ike.docs.typst.asciidoc.TypstConverter
    Creates the converter for one document.
    TypstConverterRegistry - Class in network.ike.docs.typst.asciidoc
    SPI registration of the typst backend, so any AsciidoctorJ instance with this jar on its classpath (the doc plugin, asciidoctor-maven-plugin, tests) can select backend: typst without programmatic registration.
    TypstConverterRegistry() - Constructor for class network.ike.docs.typst.asciidoc.TypstConverterRegistry
    Creates the registry (ServiceLoader entry point).
    TypstPageSetup - Class in network.ike.docs.typst
    The page and furniture setup every IKE Typst document starts with: paper, margins with a binding side, running head (title on the verso, current level-1 section on the recto), folio in the footer, fonts, paragraph and heading rules, table and raw-block styling, and the helper functions the converter's output calls (ike-admonition, ike-koncept, ike-unconverted, …).
    TypstText - Class in network.ike.docs.typst
    Text-level Typst serialization: escaping for markup mode, string literals, labels, and the protected-span convention that lets already-emitted Typst travel through a text pass untouched.

    W

    wrap(String, String, String) - Static method in class network.ike.docs.typst.TypstText
    Wraps substituted text in an opening and a closing piece of Typst, each protected on its own, leaving the text in place for the enclosing text pass to decode and escape.
